shots.prompt: The sun touches the horizon directly behind the domed mosque and slender minaret of a sand-colored city, the sky burning orange and rose. The camera holds wide as the light slips lower. Cinematic, shallow depth of field. Sound: the evening call to prayer beginning, melodic and clear, rolling across the rooftops.

Close on a hand lifting a single plump date from a brass plate in warm golden lantern light; lips murmur softly before the first bite. Cinematic, shallow depth of field. Sound: a whispered word of thanks, the quiet first bite, family exhaling around the table.

Under a thin crescent moon families walk together through lantern-lit streets of a sand-colored city toward a domed mosque, its minaret glowing warm against the deep blue night. Cinematic, shallow depth of field. Sound: many soft footsteps, warm greetings, night insects singing.

Inside the mosque long rows of worshippers stand shoulder to shoulder under glowing lanterns and patterned arches, still and attentive. Reverent, cinematic, shallow depth of field. Sound: beautiful melodic recitation filling the hall, deep collective stillness.
